insight: The blindness structure has exactly two levels: (1) terminal-output metrics are blind to ALL five violation types (structural guarantee), and (2) set-based metrics additionally detect forbidden/omission/overuse but remain blind to timing and sequence. paragraph: Table~\ref{tab:blindness} summarises the two-level blindness structure. Set-based metrics detect forbidden violations (BSR=0.0%) but remain blind to timing (BSR=10.6%) and sequence (BSR=16.7%) perturbations, since reordering or delaying actions does not alter the action \emph{set}. Only process-aware evaluation (CGA-Bench) detects all five types.
